text: 西藏自治区人民政府新闻办公室30日在吉隆县吉隆镇举行新闻发布会，自治区主席、吉隆县“8·26”泥石流灾害应急救援指挥部指挥长嘎玛泽登表示，截至29日18时，灾害造成16人遇难，546人失联。灾后抢险救援工作加速推进。嘎玛泽登从搜救工作、转移安置群众、隐患排查、善后处置等四个方面进行介绍。全力做好搜救工作，迅速启动自治区自然灾害一级应急响应、自治区自然灾害一级救助应急响应，并成立吉隆县“8·26”泥石流灾害应急救援指挥部和前方指挥部，在救援力量和资金方面，财政部、应急管理部紧急拨付1.2亿元资金，国家发展改革委安排1亿元资金，支持抢险救灾和灾后应急恢复工作
text_en: The Information Office of the Tibet Autonomous Region People's Government held a press conference in Gyirong Town, Gyirong County on the 30th. Gamazeden, chairman of the region and commander of the Gyirong County "8-26" mudslide disaster emergency rescue command, said that as of 18:00 on the 29th, the disaster had killed 16 people and left 546 missing. Rescue and relief efforts are accelerating. Gamazeden briefed on four aspects: search and rescue, relocation of affected residents, hazard screening, and aftermath handling. Full efforts are being made on search and rescue, with the region quickly activating Level I emergency response for natural disasters and Level I relief response, and establishing the Gyirong County "8-26" mudslide disaster emergency rescue command and forward command. On funding, the Ministry of Finance and Ministry of Emergency Management urgently allocated RMB 120 million, and the National Development and Reform Commission arranged RMB 100 million to support rescue and post-disaster recovery.
